name: Victor Hugo
contribution: A French Romantic author, poet, essayist, playwright, journalist, human rights activist and politician.

checks.lead: Victor-Marie Hugo, vicomte Hugo (French: [viktɔʁ maʁi yɡo] ; 26 February 1802 – 22 May 1885) was a French Romantic author, poet, essayist, playwright, journalist, human rights activist and politician.
